messages:
Alex C: Heads-up — we need a short burst top-up in uk-west1 for a customer demo tomorrow 14:00-15:00 UTC. Target: +8 A100-equivalent slots for that hour. Can someone confirm vendor availability and whether we can carve a temporary slice?
Maya P: Got it, checking quota + billing code. Do we want all on preemptible, or mix with 2 reserved for latency-sensitive probes?
Alex C: Mix sounds right — 6 preemptible + 2 guaranteed. Demo will run some latency-sensitive inference, want a stable 2-node path.
Rick G: I pinged Vendor Ops earlier — PO submitted but awaiting invoice confirmation. ETA from vendor is ~8-12h if finance ok. I can attempt to borrow 2 reserved from staging pool as a fallback.
Maya P: Ok, if vendor comes late we fallback to staging reserve. Alex, add billing tag: `demo-team:rl-demo-0426`. Also created a quick TF patch for carved slice:
```
resource "redwood_infra_slice" "rl_demo" {
  region = "uk-west1"
  gpu_count = 8
  preemptible = 6
  reserved = 2
  ttl_hours = 3
}
```
Can someone review the PR? https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/3124
Sofia (oncall): I can smoke the slice at 13:30 UTC and run a short inference run. Need the exact start time and test prompt set.
Alex C: Start 13:30 smoke, demo 14:00. Test prompts: `sweep_small.jsonl` in the demo repo. I'll post link in the PR.
Rick G: If vendor clears, I'll confirm by 03:30 UTC and tag @Maya P. If not, I'll carve from staging and post the carve ID here.
infra-bot: Quota request created (#QR-9851). Status: pending vendor confirmation.
Maya P: Reviewed the TF patch, small nit on naming, pushed one-line fix. PR ready for Rick to approve on carve fallback.
Alex C: Thanks all — tagging @Sofia for smoke run 13:30. I'll update the demo runbook with carve ID when Rick posts it. :thumbsup:
Sofia (oncall): Roger, will post results in this thread after smoke.
Alex C: Appreciate it — leaving this open until carve or vendor confirm.
